verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a local, privacy-focused AI app, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of telemetry, usage tracking, or any setting to disable them. General privacy claims such as running locally and "no data leaving your device" describe document handling, not a documented telemetry opt-out control, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
